_comment: Respellings applied at generation time only. EMPTY VALUES ARE IGNORED - add one only when a candidate has been MEASURED to help, using app/experiments/proper_noun_pronunciation.py. Judge by listening, not by WER: validation scores the transcript against the ORIGINAL text, so a respelling that makes the audio right can make WER worse.
_derived: Name list derived from character_aliases.json + voice_config.json + the script, then filtered to forms that ACTUALLY occur. Aliases are used for DISCOVERY only: 'BETTY' and 'BEATRICE' are one character but different sounds, so each written form gets its own entry.
_warning: Forms marked collides_with_common_word share a spelling with an ordinary word in this book. Matching is case-sensitive so the lowercase word is safe, but think before giving these a respelling.
